description: Defines a templated FrameType class with nested Allocator, Reader, and Writer classes for handling binary data buffers, including serialization/deserialization, buffer management, and variable-length number encoding. Contains utility functions and template specializations for endianess and size handling.

classes.name: FrameType
classes.description: A templated class for managing binary data frames with serialization, buffer management, and endianess support.

classes.name: FrameType::Reader
classes.description: Provides methods to read data from a FrameType buffer, including variable-length encoding and buffer locking.

classes.name: FrameType::Writer
classes.description: Provides methods to write data into a FrameType buffer, including variable-length encoding.

classes.name: FrameType::AllocatorType
classes.description: Manages memory allocation for the buffer, supporting dynamic resizing and different start sizes.

methods.name: buffer_length_cast
methods.description: Converts input length to a new type with safety checks.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Gets or sets the size of the frame buffer.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the frame size to zero.

methods.name: Shrink
methods.description: Reduces the frame size by removing data from the end or specified offset.

methods.name: Expand
methods.description: Increases the frame size at a specified offset.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets a buffer segment at a given offset with specified length.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves a buffer segment from the frame.

methods.name: SetText
methods.description: Sets a text string into the buffer with length prefix.

methods.name: GetText
methods.description: Retrieves a text string from the buffer.

methods.name: SetNullTerminatedText
methods.description: Sets a null-terminated string into the buffer.

methods.name: GetNullTerminatedText
methods.description: Retrieves a null-terminated string from the buffer.

methods.name: SetBoolean
methods.description: Sets a boolean value at a specified offset.

methods.name: GetBoolean
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from a specified offset.

methods.name: SetVariableNumber
methods.description: Encodes a variable-length number into the buffer.

methods.name: GetVariableNumber
methods.description: Decodes a variable-length number from the buffer.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a fixed-size number into the buffer.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a fixed-size number from the buffer.
